claims.statement: 2024 flood impacts are reported differently: p. 13 says >100,000 displaced and ~$450m loss; p. 56 says 118,000 displaced and $877m loss. Keep as a contested event variant pending scope/definition review.

records.summary: 2024 spring floods forced over 100,000 people to flee; 45,000 were children; losses about USD 450m.

records.summary: The 2024 flood table reports 118,000 people displaced and USD 877m estimated loss.
records.label_notes: observed_result_or_impact; CLM-08 / WAT-03; flood; displaced people; 2024; USD 877m
